description: Create the concise EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md as a one-page investor-ready document that a founder could show to an investor today. This summarizes the winning idea from the business plan into a compelling, professional pitch document.
steps: Include sections: Problem Statement (2-3 sentences on the pain point), Solution (what the AI product does), Market Opportunity (TAM/SAM/SOM with Uzbekistan-specific numbers), Business Model (how it makes money), Competitive Advantage (moat), Traction Plan (first 6 months milestones), Team Requirements (key hires needed), Financial Projections (Year 1-3 revenue targets), The Ask (what investment is needed and for what)
Keep it concise - one page when rendered (roughly 60-80 lines of Markdown)
Make it investor-ready: professional tone, specific numbers, clear value proposition
Reference the Uzbekistan context (government support, IT Park benefits, market size)
Include a clear call-to-action at the end
acceptance_criteria: Document is concise (under 100 lines) but comprehensive
Contains specific financial projections and market sizing
References Uzbekistan-specific advantages (IT Park tax benefits, government alignment, young population)
Includes a clear funding ask with use of proceeds
verification: Confirm file is concise but substantial: wc -l /projects/sandbox/STARTUP2/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md (should be 50-120 lines)
